dedupe_keys.name: infrastructure perception and control multi sensor object tracking dataset ipc msot

description: Infrastructure Perception and Control: Multi-Sensor Object Tracking Dataset (IPC-MSOT) is a data set described in the paper "Infrastructure Perception and Control: Multi-Sensor Object Tracking Dataset (IPC-MSOT)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2025), produced by Faizan Mir, Rimple Sandhu, Stanley Young and colleagues. Traffic intersections are challenging nodes in transportation networks where multiple lanes of vehicles and pedestrians converge. Traffic accidents often occur at traffic intersections, including a large proportion of traffic fatalities and about one-half of all traffic injuries in the United States. Coverage: signalised intersections in Colorado Springs, USA. The data are held at the linked repository, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: not stated (data set page not opened on 2026-10-01). Cost: no charge is stated in the metadata read; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic signal control and sensor fusion studies. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
